• Case Management system is the primary system where the periodic review is conducted, Risk Ranking 
system calculates the risk of the bank’s customers and Customer Database Management System is 
where the customer’s information is available on real time basis. 
• Mainly involved in various priority requirements from Clients across the world to Introduce and 
update functionalities of Case Management system while conducting the periodic review of the 
customers.
